method: Top-by-stars sample of public repositories per language; one HEAD request per tracked path on the default branch; only presence and size are recorded, never file contents.

sample.excluded_note: other = targeted but not in data/repos.json (cross-language duplicates, repos not found or dropped at seeding); the reason was not recorded per repo

denominator.definition: M = repositories in the sample whose latest scan has status ok. excluded = sample repositories outside M, each with one status: moved (redirects to another owner/name), deleted (unreachable, no redirect found), unreachable (last check failed or partial, not confirmed moved or deleted), archived, fork. Excluded repositories keep their card. M + excluded = sample_size.
